title: Next.js docs — Caching (Cache Components model)
summary: States that module imports, synchronous I/O and pure computations are 'predictable values': 'Components using only these operations are prerendered automatically, and their output becomes part of the static HTML at build time.' Lists `fs.readFileSync` explicitly among them. Contrasts this with `await readFile()` inside a component, which 'would be treated as uncached data that must be either accessed within `use cache` or behind a `<Suspense>` boundary.' Applies when cacheComponents: true.
